Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Sales Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Sales Specialist will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 6 anos atuando JAVA, com versões atuais, Springboot e Quarkus;

- Experiência em AWS ( Lambda, S3, CloudFormation, EC2, SQS e RDS);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de APIs e automações;

- Atuar profissionalmente com JavaScript e Angular 2+ para aplicações web;

- OCR para extração e leitura de informações em imagens e documentos.

- Docker para padronização e conteinerização de ambiente;

- Experiência em Grafana para monitoramento e análise de métricas;

- Experiência com Langfuse e LangChain para integração e desenvolvimento de soluções com IA generativa;

- Fundamentos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Linguagem Natural;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados (ETL, modelagem e transformação);

- Experiência com RAG.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

Pay Rate LinkedIn style:

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Investigações;
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;
  • Experiência na área de prevenção à fraude;
  • Conhecimento de coleta de dados e informações de fontes públicas (OSINT);
  • Habilitação categoria B ativa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


BENEFÍCIOS

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale refeição;
  • Auxílio material escolar (filhos);
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Wellhub;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Descontos em produtos;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Carro da empresa como ferramenta de trabalho.

title: LHP_Senior KDB/Q Developer_Remote Mexico dup
description:
Project Description:

Building a trading platform for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising of front-office system for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, intra-day positions management, order management and routing, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe).


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain KDB+/q databases and real-time data processing systems supporting trading and research.
  • Build and optimize data ingestion pipelines from multiple market data sources using Kafka.
  • Collaborate with Java developers to integrate KDB systems with trading, analytics, and risk applications.
  • Support React-based front-end interfaces by developing efficient APIs and query services for visualization and analysis.
  • Monitor and tune performance of large-scale time-series datasets for latency and throughput.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and uptime.
  • Partner with quantitative researchers and traders to design new data-driven features and analytics.



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience developing in KDB+/q within a trading or financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of time-series data, market data structures, and real-time data processing.
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux and scripting for system monitoring and automation.
  • Proficiency in query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in KDB.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, quant, and trading teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and reliability.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager


**Add resumes in English**


In this role, you will collaborate with key infrastructure stakeholders and business partners in defining project scope, interpreting requirements and priorities, and leading the modernization and transformation of systems. The projects you lead will primarily include infrastructure and application integrations and other infrastructure initiatives. Ideally you are highly skilled in communicating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and C-Suite Executives and you have a well-rounded understanding of the various components of an enterprise IT environment.


Responsabilities:

• Drive project management decisions, governance, and long-term vision.

• Analyze divisional business requirements and translate these into technical deliverables organized as Executive Milestones (In/Out of Scope).

• Develop expert 'As Is' knowledge of platform systems and help define 'To Be' system solutions and flows (e.g., must understand before planning).

• Understand infrastructure requirements and deployment of solutions for OnPrem and Cloud Computing service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).

• Analyze data to identify key insights and apply them to the business; quantitative and qualitative analysis.

• Ensure coordination of teams to drive timely completion of deliverables of large projects.

• Manage project budgets and financials, including resource allocations supporting a project’s schedule.

• Define and provide KPI’s and metrics for assigned projects.

• Interact closely with stakeholders and vendors and provide communications to executive management.

• Operationally troubleshoot or lead the troubleshooting of complex issues.

• Proactively ensure compliance (processes, standards, methodology) with expected quality.

• Responsible for project-related organizational change management including communications, training, and adoption.

• General understanding of infrastructure requirements to deploy solutions for storage, middleware, DB, voice specifics (call/contact centers), and network (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancing, WAF).

• Definition, implementation, and adoption of processes.


Requirements:

• Advanced English (mandatory)

• Bachelor’s degree and solid experience in Project/Program Management.

• Experience managing merger and acquisition infrastructure and application integration or divestiture projects preferred.

• Project Management Professional and/or Certified Scrum Master preferred.

• Experience managing requirements for multiple large, complex, and cross functional projects. Emphasis on systems, technologies, business process redesign, and knowledge of technical environments.

• Experience producing detailed project plans and resource requirements.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills – must be comfortable speaking and writing interacting with C-level audiences, as well as technical and non-technical audiences.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and negotiation skills.

• Proven ability to write business requirements, including user stories, use case development and work-flow documentation.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54563


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 6 anos atuando JAVA, com versões atuais, Springboot e Quarkus;

- Experiência em AWS ( Lambda, S3, CloudFormation, EC2, SQS e RDS);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de APIs e automações;

- Atuar profissionalmente com JavaScript e Angular 2+ para aplicações web;

- OCR para extração e leitura de informações em imagens e documentos.

- Docker para padronização e conteinerização de ambiente;

- Experiência em Grafana para monitoramento e análise de métricas;

- Experiência com Langfuse e LangChain para integração e desenvolvimento de soluções com IA generativa;

- Fundamentos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Linguagem Natural;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados (ETL, modelagem e transformação);

- Experiência com RAG.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: LHP_Senior KDB/Q Developer_Remote Mexico dup
description:
Project Description:

Building a trading platform for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising of front-office system for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, intra-day positions management, order management and routing, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe).


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain KDB+/q databases and real-time data processing systems supporting trading and research.
  • Build and optimize data ingestion pipelines from multiple market data sources using Kafka.
  • Collaborate with Java developers to integrate KDB systems with trading, analytics, and risk applications.
  • Support React-based front-end interfaces by developing efficient APIs and query services for visualization and analysis.
  • Monitor and tune performance of large-scale time-series datasets for latency and throughput.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and uptime.
  • Partner with quantitative researchers and traders to design new data-driven features and analytics.



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience developing in KDB+/q within a trading or financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of time-series data, market data structures, and real-time data processing.
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux and scripting for system monitoring and automation.
  • Proficiency in query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in KDB.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, quant, and trading teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and reliability.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

  • Build and optimize data ingestion pipelines from multiple market data sources using Kafka.
  • Collaborate with Java developers to integrate KDB systems with trading, analytics, and risk applications.
  • Support React-based front-end interfaces by developing efficient APIs and query services for visualization and analysis.
  • Monitor and tune performance of large-scale time-series datasets for latency and throughput.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and uptime.
  • Partner with quantitative researchers and traders to design new data-driven features and analytics.



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience developing in KDB+/q within a trading or financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of time-series data, market data structures, and real-time data processing.
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux and scripting for system monitoring and automation.
  • Proficiency in query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in KDB.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, quant, and trading teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and reliability.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Agencies BD & Recruited
description:
Corporate Information

TRANSSNET Group is a joint venture company established by China's leading Internet company NetEase Group (NASDAQ: NTES) and TRANSSION Holdings Group, a global provider of smart terminal products and mobile value-added services. TRANSSNET combines NetEase’s strong technical strength and advanced Internet product operation concepts with TRANSSION’s mature channel resources and solid market foundation in Africa, becoming one of the leading Internet companies serving the most users in Africa with excellent online applications from Boomplay, the largest online music platform in Africa, to TalkTalk and SOYO, both extraordinary social apps, to mobile games.


This position will serve the social app(SOYO) business unit.


Job Requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • At least one year of experience in agency recruitment or management of a social app.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to make friends with users.
  • Sales-oriented mindset with patience.
  • Enjoy using voice social apps, familiar with various features and gameplay.
  • Reliable and loyal, with integrity and a goal-oriented approach.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for recruiting agencies and hosts (at least 200-300 hosts per month)
  • Assist in the translation of events and product features (English to Portuguese)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you’re passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.



What You’ll Do:

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS , that just work — at scale.
  • Own Kubernetes clusters : architecture, automation, observability, and performance tuning.
  • Build Terraform modules and GitOps pipelines to make deployments boring (in a good way).
  • Create CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and get new features into production safely.
  • Automate everything — provisioning, monitoring, security — with the best tools for the job.
  • Push systems to 99.99% uptime across billions of transactions a year.
  • Partner directly with product engineers, security, and leadership to ship infrastructure that accelerates growth.
  • Mentor teammates, review pull requests, and help define best practices as we scale.

You Should Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps , Cloud Engineering , or Site Reliability Engineering .
  • Strong Proven track record with LAMP (Linux Apache Mysql PHP)

title: Analista de Finanças Sênior
description:
Oportunidade para atuar em uma empresa renomada no setor de saúde, referenciada por sua atuação e excelência no mercado.


Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


O analista sênior terá como principal missão garantir que os processos de recebimento fiscal estejam corretamente alinhados as práticas e políticas internas, garantindo que os documentos fiscais estejam em conformidade com as exigências legais e sejam corretamente escriturados; resolvendo inconsistências entre documentos fiscais e lançamentos contábeis. Sempre buscando identificar oportunidades de automação e melhorias no processo, participando de projetos da área de R2P.



Principais atividades:


  • Interagir com áreas internas para resolver pendências fiscais;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas;
  • Estar atualizado com mudanças na legislação tributária;
  • Apoiar em treinamentos e capacitação de equipe;
  • Participação em projetos e fóruns relacionados a temas da área;
  • Criação e acompanhamento de indicadores e relatórios da área;
  • Apoio a gestão da área.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas relacionadas);
  • Conhecimento em Excel (intermediário a avançado);
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP – módulo MM e FI, transações de Recebimento Fiscal;
  • Conhecimento dos processos e rotinas de Recebimento Fiscal;
  • Será um diferencial conhecimento das rotinas de Contas a Pagar e em demais atividades do módulo de MM (SAP).


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos.


Informações da vaga:


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office.

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00h as 17:48h segunda a sexta-feira.


O que oferecemos:


Assistência Médica e Odontológica;

Vale-Alimentação e Vale-Refeição;

Vale-Transporte;

Auxílio-Creche;

Seguro de Vida;

Wellhub;

Participação nos Lucros;

Previdência Privada.

If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: ASSISTENTE DE CUSTOMER SUCCESS
description:
Missão do cargo:

Atuar como ponto de apoio técnico durante o período de implantação, garantindo que clientes tenham suas dúvidas esclarecidas de forma ágil, clara e eficiente. O profissional será responsável por acompanhar demandas via chat e ticket, orientar usuários, organizar informações e contribuir para o andamento do projeto, sempre mantendo comunicação empática, precisa e alinhada às equipes envolvidas.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atuar no Sucesso do Cliente e os interesses do negócio com a solução e serviços adquiridos, para entregar uma melhor experiência de uso em todas as etapas da jornada na TOTVS;
  • Atender dúvidas técnicas durante a implantação, principalmente via chat e ticket;
  • Acompanhar solicitações dos clientes;
  • Analisar situações, identificar causas e propor soluções alinhadas ao processo de implantação;
  • Encaminhar demandas para áreas internas quando necessário, garantindo comunicação clara e objetiva;
  • Orientar usuários sobre funcionalidades, processos e boas práticas do sistema;
  • Garantir fluidez e eficiência nos atendimentos.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Ensino médio completo. Desejável ensino superior cursando na área de Tecnologia, Recursos Humanos, Administração ou correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office e GSuite - nível básico
  • Desejável vivência na área de atendimento ao cliente através de chat, e-mails e/ou tickets.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de atendimento omnichannel (chat, ticket, telefone) como Zendesk, Movidesk ou similares será um diferencial.

title: Pesssoa Analista de Sucesso do Cliente Pleno (Fraude/Compliance)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do cargo :

Realizar a gestão de uma carteira de clientes Enterprise , focada nas soluções de prevenção a perdas da Neowa y (Compliance, Fraude, APIs, etc).


Responsabilidades:

  • Tornar-se um especialista em produtos da Neoway usar esse conhecimento para guiar efetivamente os clientes em direção aos seus resultados desejados;
  • Gerenciar um portfolio de aproximadamente 20 clientes Enterprise;
  • Criação e manutenção de relacionamento com alta liderança (gerentes, heads e diretores) das contas mais estratégicas;
  • Identificação, desenvolvimento e aplicação de estratégias de mitigação de riscos (evitar downsell/churns);
  • Acompanhamento e Rotina de Atendimento (Touches, Treinamentos, QBRs, implementação de projetos) e planejamento de Contas (Account Planning);
  • Monitoramento de métricas de sucesso do cliente;
  • Mapeamento e Criação de Cases de Sucesso e Avaliação e Mapeamento de Retorno do Investimento (ROI) dos projetos
  • Desenvolvimento e Apresentação de Estudos Estratégicos para os clientes
  • Integração entre as áreas da companhia para atender solicitações do cliente.
  • Realizar engajamentos contínuos com os clientes para demonstrar valor e rastrear resultados de negócios (reuniões mensais, QBRs, agendas executivas, etc.)


Você fará a diferença se apresentar:

  • Ter atuado em empresa SAAS
  • Experiência com Produtos de Fraude / Compliance
  • Habilidade em planejamento de contas e acompanhamento de projetos.
  • Capacidade analítica para realizar apresentações de estudos estratégicos para os clientes.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar estratégias de upsell e cross-sell.
  • Excelente habilidade em engajamento de clientes para demonstração de valor e rastreamento de resultados de negócios.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de sucesso do cliente e avaliação de Retorno de investimento de projetos.
  • Ter mentalidade proativa e colaborativa, excelente habilidade de gerenciamento de tempo, capacidade de lidar com várias contas e atribuições simultaneamente.
  • Autonomia, Pró-Atividade e Accountability;

description:
Estamos contratando: Desenvolvedor(a) Mendix Sênior

Quer trabalhar em projetos de alto impacto usando a plataforma low-code que mais cresce no mundo?

Somos um integrador oficial Mendix no Brasil, e buscamos alguém para criar soluções digitais inovadoras para clientes de diversos setores.


O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver aplicações ponta-a-ponta em Mendix Studio Pro.
  • Criar integrações complexas com APIs, sistemas legados e novas tecnologias.
  • Definir arquitetura e boas práticas para projetos Mendix.
  • Explorar IA e automação para soluções inteligentes.
  • Treinar e apoiar times de clientes.

✅ O que buscamos

  • 3+ anos de experiência em projetos Mendix completos.
  • Domínio de Mendix Studio Pro (UX, microflows/nanoflows, integrações, Java Actions).
  • Certificação Mendix Intermediate ou Advanced .
  • Base sólida em desenvolvimento de software (Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis .
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.
  • Desejável Integração Mendix com ERP, CRM ou IoT.
  • Desejável experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis

Por que vir para cá

  • Projetos desafiadores e inovadores.
  • Certificações e treinamentos oficiais Mendix.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e oportunidade real de crescimento.

title: Senior Medical Advisor
description:
At Biocon Biologics, we are creating a model for the future of healthcare for all. We are a leading company in the biosimilars revolution where patients come first. Our ambition is to impact a billion lives and we do this by fostering a culture of affordable innovation, patient-centricity, and disruptive thinking. We are a multicultural global company where employees have a purpose and passion to work closely with partners and patients. We have a long-term commitment to bringing high-quality affordable biosimilars to patients all over the globe. We have proven end-to-end expertise from clone development, manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory approvals to commercialization in developed and emerging markets.



Role: Sr Medical Advisor, Medical Affairs

Location- São Paulo, Brazil


We are seeking a candidate in Brazil Region as Medical Advisor within the Clinical Development and Medical Affairs organization. Reporting to the EM Head of Medical Affairs; the Medical Advisor will be involved in KOL engagement/ HCP interactions and provide Scientific support to KOLs /HCP to execute the core medico marketing strategies as well as support with Pharmacovigilance activities.


Responsibilities


  • Build a network of key opinion leaders through enhanced scientific interfaces and best practices
  • Engage and build robust relationships with HCPs, and KOLs on value, access, and pharmaco-economic areas, also seek advice on unmet needs for patients and other stakeholders
  • Develop/validate appropriate scientific content for conferences, briefing meetings & other policy-related activities/initiatives
  • Assist in the planning of new campaigns and launch activities
  • Be a brand ambassador for Biocon Biologics and its products
  • Safeguard patient benefit always through the application of relevant knowledge of science, regulations, and compliance in all initiatives undertaken by the organization
  • Prepare educational material/ videos/ website content/ patient information leaflets in collaboration with the medical affairs Centre of Excellence and marketing for relevant therapies.
  • Ideate evidence generation through IITs and registries in line with strategy, addressing concerns/feedback from the HCPs, patients, and other stakeholders
  • Author publications/blogs/white papers related to the value and differentiation of our products
  • Collaborate with the training team in updating and reviewing slide decks/manuals and other relevant materials
  • Promote patient centricity within Biocon Biologics
  • Provide valid scientific responses to all the medical queries from the customers regarding the products and therapy area involved
  • Promote diversity & inclusion in clinical trials, and data and get involved in ESG objectives as it pertains to medical affairs
  • Together with the global teams, formulate meaningful real-world evidence studies, and support clinical strategy and execution related to registration and post-registration clinical trials.
  • “Responsible for local Pharmacovigilance communications for the Pharmacovigilance System of the Registration Holder of Medicament
  • To have oversight of the Pharmacovigilance system of the PRH/MAH in terms of structure and performance and to ensure directly or through supervision that the system components and processes are in place.
  • Thorough understanding of the safety profiles of the products under the responsibility of the Medication Registration Holder
  • Reside in Brazilian territory and be available to attend PV-related requirements and inspections.
  • Promote inclusions and suggestions in the Risk Management Plans and Periodic Benefit-Risk Assessment Reports
  • Ensure adequate and timely submission of expedited adverse reaction reports, PBRERs and other safety reports to the regulatory agencies as per applicable local regulations.
  • To have oversight on weekly literature searches and to report the valid ICSRs to the regulatory agency in the territory as per the applicable regulations.
  • To alert the Authority of any emerging safety issue(s) involving registered products. ”


Other basic requirements include:


  • Ability to interact with senior internal and external personnel
  • Attention to detail and taking accountability
  • Ability to work across more than a few therapy areas
  • Create sense of purpose and inspiration in the team
  • Must be able to work in a team environment, working closely with cross-functional teams
  • Collaborate with medical affairs colleagues in other countries/regions and share knowledge and learnings
  • Functional expertise in MS office, Veeva Vault
  • Substantial knowledge and understanding of policies, procedures, and guidelines relevant to medical affairs operations
  • Substantial knowledge of HCP policies and regulations
  • Proven understanding of the needs of individuals living with cancer and chronic diseases like diabetes or other autoimmune diseases as well as pressing public health issues, including at the pharmacy and HCP levels.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred (e.g., MS, Pharm D, Ph.D., or MD);
  • Minimum 05 years of medical affairs, patient access, and advocacy experience in the biopharmaceutical, or relevant non-profit or payer industry.
  • Must be willing and able to travel (approximately 30%) regionally, including to other countries within the EM region.



Biocon Biologics is an Equal Opportunity, EEO / Affirmative Action Employer committed to excellence through diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and no employee shall be discriminated against because of their race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability, genetic information, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

title: Coletor de Mídia
description:
Responsável pela coleta de dados de programação e veiculações em diferentes plataformas de mídia, como TV aberta, TV fechada, rádio, serviços de streaming, etc.


Atividades :


  • Coletar todos os dias a programação e os intervalos comerciais de todas as plataformas de mídia que fazem parte da cobertura da Kantar.
  • Avisar a área de suporte sempre que houver alguma falha na gravação de um programa ou intervalo, para que possam identificar e corrigir o problema.
  • Informar a equipe de Preços quando houver diferença entre o programa cadastrado no sistema e o que foi realmente exibido.
  • Garantir que o registro dos anunciantes exibidos esteja correto. Se não for possível identificar o anunciante, acionar a área de Pesquisa para confirmar com as agências.
  • Testar e validar melhorias no sistema que impactem o trabalho do dia a dia.
  • Revisar e corrigir eventuais erros identificados.
  • Participar dos projetos da área sempre que for solicitado.
  • Realizar outras atividades relacionadas, conforme orientação do superior.


Escala: 5x2 Rotativa, garantindo 2 folgas por semana e 1 fim de semana por mês;

Horário de trabalho: 14h às 23h

Modelo : 100% remoto


O que é necessário?

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário de Informática (Pcte Office, Edição de Vídeos, etc.)


Desejável :

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando: em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Rádio e TV ou relacionados.


O que oferecemos:

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Salário fixo
  • Ajuda de custo
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Day off de Aniversário;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Convênio com Farmácias;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa de Qualidade de Vida: Total Pass; ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana; palestras sobre temas relevantes; vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais.
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
About WSO2:

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.
  • Native portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.
  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • An opportunity for professional growth and development.
  • A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.
  • Native portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.
  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • An opportunity for professional growth and development.
  • A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

Payment in dollars.

title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

title: Pessoa Assistente Tributário (ICMS)  | Atacadão
description:
Maior atacadista brasileiro em número de lojas, o Atacadão está presente em mais de 190 cidades espalhadas por todos os estados do Brasil. Com uma história de 60 anos e mais de 60 mil colaboradores, a empresa tem mais de 280 unidades de autosserviço e 33 atacados de entrega, que garantem o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais. Também atua no e-commerce, integrando o canal de vendas online do próprio Atacadão com uma robusta operação de marketplace, com mais de 300 sellers parceiros de atacado. Em 2021, pela sexta vez, o Atacadão foi eleito pelo "Prêmio Época Reclame Aqui" como a empresa que melhor atendeu seus clientes dentre todos os supermercados e atacados do Brasil. A rede também lidera o Ranking ABAAS, a Associação Brasileira dos Atacadistas de Autosserviço que elenca as redes que mais faturaram em 2021.


GRUPO CARREFOUR BRASIL


Somos hoje o maior empregador privado do País com 150 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros e brasileiras, colaborando assim com a saúde e o bem-estar de todos e todas.

Com a aquisição do grupo BIG, em junho de 2022, demos início a mais uma etapa da nossa jornada que já dura 47 anos no Brasil. Unimos o melhor dos dois grupos e somos agora uma empresa mais diversa, com maior capacidade de inovar e causar impacto positivo na sociedade. Além de gerar mais de R$ 100 Bilhões em receitas e liderança no setor de 23% de Market Share.

Estamos investindo fortemente na simplificação e na aceleração digital, pois acreditamos que esse é o caminho para nos transformar e sermos protagonistas da mudança que queremos ver no país.

Trabalhar no Grupo Carrefour Brasil é participar diariamente de tudo isso, em um ambiente que respeita e acolhe as diferenças com muito espaço para crescer e aprender. Somos muitos e queremos ser ainda mais.

E você também pode fazer parte dessa grande jornada. Com você, seremos ainda maiores.


Localização: Próximo a ponte do Tatuapé


DO DISCURSO À PRÁTICA


Sobre a área: A área do Tributário (ICMS) é responsável pela apuração de ICMS em todos os estados do país e o cumprimento de obrigações principais e acessórias.


Desafios dessa posição:

• Realizar apuração de ICMS e Cumprimento de obrigações acessórias;

• Realizar pagamento de ICMS de diversos estados;

• Realizar conciliação fiscal/contábil dos estabelecimentos.


Você precisa ter:

• Cursando ensino superior em Ciências Contábeis ou Administração;

• Experiência em apuração de ICMS.


Adoraríamos se você tiver:

• Conhecimento intermediário em Excel.


VOCÊ MERECE O MELHOR

● Vale-transporte ou estacionamento no local

● Restaurante no local

● Assistência médica opcional (Intermédica – Enfermaria, sem mensalidade)

● Seguro de vida

● PAC TotalPass (acesso a academias e estúdios parceiros)

● Enxoval de bebê

● Auxílio-creche

● Cartão Atacadão


No Grupo Carrefour a valorização da diversidade e a promoção de uma cultura inclusiva é um compromisso. Aqui queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam incluídas!


Se identificou? Conheça as nossas vagas, inscreva-se e vamos juntos mudar o mundo através da alimentação! #MelhoresJuntosMaioresComVocê

title: Java Fullstack Developer SR
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both front-end and back-end development, with a passion for building scalable and efficient applications. As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance web applications that meet the needs of our clients and stakeholders.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Development of new features;
  • Maintenance of existing applications;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Implement solution from coding to testing to production deployment support;

  • Proficiency in Backend Java and Java Spring Boot;
  • Experience with automated testing in Java (e.g. Unit Test, Integration Test, etc.);
  • Solid experience with Python;
  • Solid Front-end development experience, especially with React (or any other SPA)
  • Experience with Typescript;
  • Experience with Microservices Architecture;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services-based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience using AWS services;
  • Good knowledge on relational and non-relational databases, be able to work with Postgres and MongoDB;

title: LHP_Senior KDB/Q Developer_Remote Mexico dup
description:
Project Description:

Building a trading platform for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising of front-office system for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, intra-day positions management, order management and routing, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe).


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain KDB+/q databases and real-time data processing systems supporting trading and research.
  • Build and optimize data ingestion pipelines from multiple market data sources using Kafka.
  • Collaborate with Java developers to integrate KDB systems with trading, analytics, and risk applications.
  • Support React-based front-end interfaces by developing efficient APIs and query services for visualization and analysis.
  • Monitor and tune performance of large-scale time-series datasets for latency and throughput.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and uptime.
  • Partner with quantitative researchers and traders to design new data-driven features and analytics.



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience developing in KDB+/q within a trading or financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of time-series data, market data structures, and real-time data processing.
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux and scripting for system monitoring and automation.
  • Proficiency in query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in KDB.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, quant, and trading teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and reliability.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate
